title: Why Families, Retirees & Remote Workers Love Boone NC
excerpt: Boone, NC has become one of the most sought-after destinations in the Southeast for families, retirees, and remote workers looking for a better quality of life. Here's why so many people are choosing to plant roots in the High Country — and what the real estate market looks like right now.
